disposition_reason: Reprints the five-batch Schizochytrium oil analytical data first published in the EFSA 2022 opinion (10.2903/j.efsa.2022.7083); those results are counted once, from the 2022 record. 25 reprinted rows kept under findings_reprinted for audit.

study.design: EFSA NDA Panel novel-food safety opinion on a resubmitted application; applicant batch-to-batch compositional data (5 batches)
study.origin: Applicant's commercial fermentation of Schizochytrium limacinum strain ATCC-20889; production site not stated
study.method: Mercury by AOAC 18th edition; other metals by Chp-9 ICP (AOAC), per Table 1
lod: LOQs printed in the table cells: tHg 0.01 mg/kg; Cd 0.01 mg/kg; tAs 0.01 mg/kg; Pb 0.01 mg/kg; Cu 0.01 mg/kg
study.qa: Panel states the applicant provided information on the accreditation of the laboratories; no CRM or recovery data reported in the opinion

unresolved: The Table 1 batch data (sterols, metals) are identical to those in the 2022 opinion on Schizochytrium sp. ATCC 20889 oil (10.2903/j.efsa.2022.7083); these are the same five batches and must not be counted as independent evidence.
Batch production dates are not reported.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Proposed use: NF added to infant formula and follow-on formula to supply DHA at the mandatory 20-50 mg/100 kcal (Regulation (EU) 2016/127)
